principle: Only meaningful, public-safe engineering work is published. Raw commits, private conversations, credentials, proprietary logic and unverified claims stay out of the public feed.

active.title: Light editorial convergence and release validation
active.summary: Aixion Lab is converging on its locked light-mineral editorial authority while reducing template repetition, tightening public state language and preserving evidence, career and accessibility boundaries.
active.evidence: The stabilized candidate passes production build, static export and the complete desktop/mobile browser suite before the next composition changes are admitted.
active.next_gate: Complete the editorial composition pass, review fresh desktop/mobile artifacts and preserve a green regression baseline.

entries.title: Hydration and regression baseline stabilized
entries.summary: A Home-only hydration mismatch, stale browser assertions, semantic landmark duplication and Career-mode regression were corrected before further visual work continued.
entries.evidence: The stabilized release candidate passes TypeScript, production build, static export, browser-error checks, accessibility, interactions and desktop/mobile visual capture gates.
entries.next_gate: Keep every design iteration subordinate to the same release gates.

entries.title: Observable Temporal State Field experiment archived as site-wide authority
entries.summary: The dark observable-system treatment was useful for exploring state-driven interaction, but it conflicted with the locked light-mineral visual authority and created a second brand system. The site-wide dark direction was superseded; public-safe state-model ideas remain available as interaction concepts.
entries.evidence: The design audit preserved the useful state, evidence and reduced-motion ideas while restoring the primary light editorial authority and explicit truth boundaries.
entries.next_gate: Reuse observable-state ideas only when they fit the light editorial system and are bound to real public-safe data.

entries.title: Discoverability, public proof and recruiter handoff hardening
entries.summary: Post-launch review tightened how Aixion Lab is discovered, shared and trusted: production-facing placeholders were removed, evidence summaries became more explicit and public identity was strengthened without adding unverified claims.
entries.evidence: The review used production-tested desktop/mobile artifacts and existing accessibility, interaction and visual regression gates rather than unverified presentation claims.
entries.next_gate: Continue publishing only evidence-backed recruiter and public-proof improvements.

entries.title: Editorial closing principle became the authored site endpoint
entries.summary: The closing statement was rebuilt from an oversized repeated text block into an intentional footer-level editorial signature with a quieter supporting sign-off.
entries.evidence: The production browser suite measures footer structure, line wrapping and desktop/mobile behavior.
entries.next_gate: Keep the full manifesto at the site endpoint rather than repeating it as page boilerplate.

entries.title: Public worklog and activity publishing
entries.summary: Ongoing Aixion engineering work feeds a curated public activity layer that surfaces current work, evidence and next gates without exposing raw repository or conversation data.
entries.evidence: Home and Pulse read from a structured public-safe activity manifest, with dedicated worklog acceptance tests in the production suite.
entries.next_gate: Use the manifest for meaningful milestones and keep publication evidence-led.

entries.title: Aixion Signal became the interaction language
entries.summary: The site uses state-driven motion, architecture-specific reveal patterns and reduced-motion fallbacks instead of generic decorative animation.
entries.evidence: Interaction acceptance tests and desktop/mobile renders exercise the signal and reduced-motion behavior.
entries.next_gate: Evolve the signal into a more distinctive lifecycle grammar without making it decorative.

entries.title: Light-mineral website authority reaffirmed
entries.summary: The clean rebuild remains anchored to the light soft-neutral mineral visual system, public architecture, maturity vocabulary and evidence boundaries.
entries.evidence: The master blueprint and visual-design authority govern page architecture, light visual language, accessibility and public/private evidence boundaries.
entries.next_gate: Keep later experiments subordinate to the locked authority unless a new authority is explicitly approved.

entries.title: Research and live evidence kept separate from proprietary strategy detail
entries.summary: The public TradeBot story exposes architecture, validation method and evidence boundaries without publishing private signal mechanics or execution rules.
entries.evidence: Public pages distinguish research evidence, live observation, risk and human authority instead of collapsing them into one claim.
entries.next_gate: Add sanitized operational proof only when it is safe and evidence-backed.

entries.title: MVP orchestration translated into inspectable stages
entries.summary: Intent, context, planning, agents, tools, evidence, policy and authority were separated into explicit stages for the public architecture.
entries.evidence: The site presents a labelled demo trace while explicitly avoiding fake production telemetry.
entries.next_gate: Promote a policy-bound execution trace backed by implementation evidence.
